captions.caption: A soldier in military uniform fires a mounted machine gun from the deck of a ship.
The soldier continues firing the machine gun as another soldier stands nearby.
Smoke emerges from the barrel of the machine gun after a burst of fire.
A close-up view shows the machine gun mounted on a tripod on the ship's deck.
Soldiers in camouflage gear inspect and prepare the machine gun for further use.
One soldier adjusts the top cover of the machine gun while another watches.
A soldier opens the feed tray cover of the machine gun to check the ammunition belt.
The soldier closes the cover and prepares to fire the weapon again.
A soldier grips the handles of the machine gun, aiming it towards the open sea.
Two soldiers work together to ensure the machine gun is properly loaded.
The soldier pulls back the charging handle of the machine gun to chamber a round.
A soldier fires a short burst from the machine gun into the water.
The machine gun recoils as it fires multiple rounds in quick succession.
Soldiers monitor the firing process, standing on the ship's deck.
Another burst of fire is released from the machine gun towards a distant target.
Expended shell casings are ejected from the side of the weapon.
A soldier continues to fire the machine gun, focusing on the target area.
The machine gun vibrates intensely as it discharges rounds rapidly.
Soldiers coordinate their actions while operating the heavy weaponry.
A soldier fires a long sequence of rounds from the mounted machine gun.
The barrel of the machine gun remains pointed towards the horizon.
A different soldier takes a turn at the machine gun, aiming carefully.
The soldier fires the machine gun, with smoke visible around the barrel.
The machine gun is fired in controlled bursts by the soldier.
Soldiers in full tactical gear observe the live-fire exercise.
The machine gun continues to fire, sending rounds across the water.
A soldier adjusts his stance while operating the large-caliber weapon.
Multiple rounds are fired from the machine gun in a continuous stream.
The soldier's hands are seen firmly on the machine gun's controls.
Smoke and muzzle flash are visible as the machine gun is fired.
The soldier maintains a steady aim while discharging the weapon.
The machine gun's belt of ammunition feeds into the receiver during firing.
Soldiers work in unison to manage the machine gun's operation.
The machine gun is fired again, creating splashes in the distant water.
A soldier watches the impact of the rounds on the surface of the sea.
The machine gun remains mounted and ready for the next sequence of fire.
An overhead view shows a soldier firing the machine gun down at the water.
The ammunition belt moves rapidly as the machine gun is fired.
Splashes appear on the water's surface where the rounds are hitting.
The soldier fires another burst, aiming at a specific area in the sea.
Spent casings fall onto the deck as the machine gun operates.
The machine gun's barrel points downward towards the target in the water.
A continuous stream of fire is directed from the ship into the ocean.
The soldier shifts the aim of the machine gun slightly while firing.
More splashes are visible in the water as the rounds strike the surface.
The machine gun continues to discharge rounds at a high rate of fire.
The soldier stops firing momentarily to reassess the target.
A long-range shot shows bullets splashing around a red target buoy.
The red buoy bobbing in the water is surrounded by numerous splashes from gunfire.
Rounds hit the water in a line leading towards the red target buoy.
The machine gun fire continues to impact the area around the floating target.
Splashes from the bullets rise high into the air near the buoy.
The red buoy is nearly obscured by the frequent water splashes.
Gunfire continues to strike the water in the vicinity of the target.
The camera pans slightly to show the extent of the impact zone in the sea.
A large splash occurs right next to the red target buoy.
The sequence of shots hitting the water continues around the buoy.
A closer view shows multiple rounds hitting the red buoy directly.
The buoy is tossed around by the impact of the machine gun rounds.
Final shots in the sequence hit the water and the buoy, concluding the exercise.
